# PottoTools: Free Online PDF, Document & Image Tools

> PottoTools (https://pottotools.in) is a free, privacy-first online suite of productivity tools for PDFs, Microsoft Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), images, and government exam photo/signature formatting. All processing runs entirely inside the user's web browser using client-side WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and modern web APIs. No documents or personal data are ever uploaded to remote servers or stored in the cloud.

## Core Principles & System Overview

- **Service Name**: PottoTools
- **Canonical URL**: https://pottotools.in/
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Client-Side. Documents and files never leave the user's device. No cloud storage, no remote telemetry on user files, no server-side retention.
- **Access & Pricing**: 100% Free forever. No subscriptions, no registration, no daily conversion quotas, and no email required.
- **Browser Compatibility**: Fully responsive across Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge, and modern mobile browsers.

## PDF Tools & Utilities

- [Compress PDF](https://pottotools.in/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file sizes down to strict targets (100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB) with smart downsampling and stream compression.
- [Merge PDF](https://pottotools.in/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file with drag-and-drop page reordering.
- [Split PDF](https://pottotools.in/split-pdf): Extract specific page ranges, split into single pages, or extract odd/even page sequences.
- [PDF Page Organizer](https://pottotools.in/pdf-page-organizer): Visually reorder, rotate individual pages, and delete unwanted sheets in large PDFs up to 500 MB.
- [PDF to Editable Word](https://pottotools.in/pdf-to-editable-word): Convert scanned or digital PDFs into genuine, fully editable Word (.docx) documents with OCR fallback.
- [PDF to Word](https://pottotools.in/pdf-to-word): Fast direct conversion from digital PDF files into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) format.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://pottotools.in/delete-pdf-pages): Remove specific pages or page intervals from any PDF.
- [Watermark PDF](https://pottotools.in/watermark-pdf): Add customizable text watermarks with transparency, rotation, and positioning controls.
- [Page Numbers](https://pottotools.in/page-numbers-pdf): Number PDF pages automatically with customizable positions and format.
- [Protect PDF](https://pottotools.in/protect-pdf): Encrypt PDF documents with strong AES-128/256 passwords to prevent unauthorized viewing.
- [Sign PDF](https://pottotools.in/sign-pdf): Draw, type, or upload digital signatures and place them anywhere on PDF pages.
- [PDF & ID Redactor](https://pottotools.in/pdf-id-redactor): Permanently blackout or pixel-blur Aadhaar numbers, bank accounts, PAN, and salary slips 100% offline.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://pottotools.in/pdf-metadata): View document metadata (title, author, producer, creation date) and strip tracking info.
- [Searchable PDF Finder](https://pottotools.in/searchable-pdf-text-finder): Search for words, names, and amounts inside scanned PDFs and export as searchable PDF with OCR.
- [PDF Text Extractor](https://pottotools.in/pdf-text-extractor): Fast extraction of raw text stream and layout structure from PDF documents.
- [PDF to Images](https://pottotools.in/pdf-to-images): Export every page of a PDF document as high-resolution JPG or PNG images.
- [PDF to Excel](https://pottotools.in/pdf-to-excel): Extract data tables from PDFs into structured CSV and Excel spreadsheets.

## Image Tools & Photo Studio

- [Custom Photo Studio](https://pottotools.in/custom-photo-studio): Precision image resizing in pixels (px), centimeters (cm), millimeters (mm), and inches (in) with aspect ratio lock, crop, and KB compression.
- [Photo Size Compressor](https://pottotools.in/photo-size-compressor): Compress photos to exact target file sizes in KB or MB with iterative quality optimization.
- [Image Format Converter](https://pottotools.in/image-converter): Convert images bidirectionally between JPG, PNG, WebP, and BMP formats with quality adjustments.
- [Photo Editor](https://pottotools.in/photo-editor): In-browser image editor with cropping, rotation, flip, brightness, contrast, and saturation controls.
- [HD Image Enhancer](https://pottotools.in/hd-image-enhancer): Enhance photo sharpness, clarity, contrast, and high-resolution upscaling using unsharp masking.
- [Crop, Rotate & Straighten](https://pottotools.in/crop-rotate-straighten): Precision aspect-ratio cropping (1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 16:9), free crop, and angle adjustment.
- [Photo Background Changer](https://pottotools.in/photo-background-changer): Replace photo backgrounds with standard white, light blue, or light gray.
- [Passport Photo Cropper](https://pottotools.in/passport-photo-cropper): Format photos to official 35x45mm passport dimensions with printable multi-photo sheets.
- [Exam Photo & Signature Resizer](https://pottotools.in/photo-signature-resizer): Verified presets for UPSC, SSC, IBPS, State PSC, Railway (RRB), GATE, NEET, and JEE requirements.
- [Combine Application Documents](https://pottotools.in/combine-app-documents): Merge ID proofs, signatures, and certificates into a single consolidated PDF.
- [Image to PDF](https://pottotools.in/image-to-pdf): Combine multiple photos (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single multi-page PDF.
- [JPG to PNG](https://pottotools.in/jpg-to-png): Convert JPEG photos to PNG with transparency support.
- [PNG to JPG](https://pottotools.in/png-to-jpg): Convert transparent PNG graphics into lightweight JPG images.

## Document Conversion & Office Tools

- [Word to PDF](https://pottotools.in/word-to-pdf): Convert Word (.docx) documents directly into high-fidelity PDF files in the browser.
- [DOCX to TXT](https://pottotools.in/docx-to-txt): Extract clean plain text from Word DOCX files.
- [DOCX to HTML](https://pottotools.in/docx-to-html): Convert Word documents into semantic HTML web markup.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://pottotools.in/powerpoint-to-pdf): Convert PPTX presentation slide decks into PDF documents.
- [Excel to PDF](https://pottotools.in/excel-to-pdf): Convert spreadsheets into printable, paginated PDF documents.
- [CSV to XLSX](https://pottotools.in/csv-to-xlsx): Convert comma-separated CSV files into standard Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.
- [XLSX to CSV](https://pottotools.in/xlsx-to-csv): Convert Excel workbooks into universal CSV data files.
- [Spreadsheet Viewer](https://pottotools.in/sheet-viewer): Interactively view and inspect Excel and CSV data directly in the browser.
- [TXT to PDF](https://pottotools.in/txt-to-pdf): Turn plain text files into formatted, printable PDF documents.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://pottotools.in/markdown-to-pdf): Render Markdown source code directly into styled PDF pages.
- [OCR Scanner](https://pottotools.in/ocr-tool): Extract editable text from scanned PDFs, photos, and receipts using in-browser OCR (English & Hindi).
- [Text Diff Comparator](https://pottotools.in/text-diff-comparator): Side-by-side visual difference comparison between document revisions.
- [Text Cleaner](https://pottotools.in/text-cleaner): Remove duplicate lines, normalize whitespace, clean line breaks, and format strings.

## Privacy & Security Verification

All file operations at PottoTools execute strictly in memory on the client machine using:
- `pdf-lib` for client-side PDF document manipulation
- `pdfjs-dist` for in-browser PDF rendering and canvas extraction
- `docx` and `jszip` for client-side Word document generation and unpacking
- `xlsx` for in-browser spreadsheet parsing and generation
- `tesseract.js` WebAssembly engine for client-side OCR
- HTML5 Canvas and WebGL for image processing, resizing, and enhancement

No document payload or extracted text is transmitted over the internet to any server.
